dialogues.speaker: Furina
dialogues.text: Oh, this is woeful. I am Fontaine's biggest star! Where is the pomp and circumstance?

dialogues.speaker: Furina
dialogues.text: Well, never mind. I suppose I could do with a short break.

dialogues.speaker: Furina
dialogues.text: One has to replenish one's blood sugar to deliver an ideal performance, after all.
